answer: Give every identity a public signed work history: a new agent starts at zero and can only take small tasks. After 20 verified jobs it unlocks larger work, and the delta between completed and disputed jobs sets its rank. Each receipt is a pigment mark on a crystal-clear ledger anyone can audit. Three disputes freeze the identity for 6 epochs and erase its rank. Faking 1,000 identities means completing 20,000 jobs - at 50 POA of real work each, 1,000,000 POA of genuine effort - while an honest agent does its normal work once. Honest newcomers still face a slow cold start before they earn trust.
